summary.en: The Colombian army has carried out air strikes that killed senior Gulf Clan leaders and several members, while cocaine-linked militias are using Ukraine-style drones, including a strike that killed four soldiers. Venezuela and Colombia have launched a joint border security operation after kidnappings, and a grenade blast hit RCN's Cali offices, targeting journalists. Ex-soldiers were sentenced for killing civilians and for executions, and a Colombian accused by the US of trafficking cocaine and supporting FARC dissidents remains under investigation. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den colombianske hæren har gjennomført luftangrep som drepte ledende medlemmer av Gulf-klanen og flere andre, mens narkotikaknyttede milits bruker droner i ukrainsk stil, inkludert et angrep som drepte fire soldater. Venezuela og Colombia har igangsatt en felles grenseoperasjon etter kidnappinger, og en granat eksploderte i RCNs kontor i Cali, rettet mot journalister. Tidligere soldater ble dømt for å ha drept sivile og for henrettelser, og en colombianer som USA anklager for narkotikasmugling og støtte til FARC-dissidenter, er fortsatt under etterforskning. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
